(() => { const g = window.__ml.game.getState().gameOver; if (!g) return 'kein gameOver'; window.__over = g; window.__ml.game.setState({ gameOver: { ...g, reward: undefined, rewardStatus: 'pending' } }); return 'pending' })()
(() => { window.__ml.game.setState({ gameOver: { ...window.__over, reward: undefined, rewardStatus: 'queued' } }); return 'queued' })()
